title: The Dow Market Happenings For Friday, January 26, 2018
text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Friday, January 26, 2018 Posted by admin on January 26th,   Goldman Sachs (GS), JPMorgan (JPM), Coca Cola (KO), 3M (MMM), Nike (NKE), Travelers (TRV), Verizon (VZ) and Wal-Mart (WMT).   +36 points. 
Thursday the Dow was up +140.67 (+0.54%) at 26,392.79. 
Year-to-date the Dow is up +6.77%. 
There were 21 Dow stocks up Thursday. 
The Dow stock winners Thursday were led by Boeing (BA) +2.52% and 3M (MMM) +1.89%. 
The Dow stock losers Thursday were led by Apple (AAPL) -1.79% and General Electric (GE) -1.58%. 
Intel (INTC -0.46%) rallied more than 3% in after-hours trading after it reported Q4 revenue of $17.05 billion, much better than consensus of $16.35 billion. 
European stocks are higher and Asian markets ended mostly higher.
